item.title: Free Admission to Greek State Archaeological Sites & Museums
item.description: On Sunday, December 7, 2025 – the first Sunday of the month – free entry to all state-run archaeological sites, museums, and monuments in Greece managed by the Ministry of Culture. item.title: Chernobyl Protective Shield Loses Confinement Function After Drone Strike, IAEA Says
